URARA Clinic treatment details, side effects, and downtime estimates

The main treatments offered at URARA Clinic include:fat cooling・GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat-dissolving injections, medical EMS, genetic testing, etc.

Since each approach uses a different mechanism, the expected course of change and possible side effects and downtime will also differ for each treatment.

Overview of side effects and downtime by treatment
  • Fat cooling: Temporary dullness of redness and sensation after treatment and approximate progress
  • GLP-1 receptor agonist: Individual differences in gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea
  • Characteristics and precautions for fat-dissolving injections, medical EMS, and genetic testing

In many cases, a plan that combines multiple treatments is proposed during a preliminary consultation.Downtime and precautions for each treatmentKnowing this in advance will be helpful when considering the day of the event.

Please note that the degree of reaction and progress varies from person to person depending on your constitution, treatment area, and physical condition, so it is best to discuss any concerns with your doctor at the time of your pre-examination.

Fat freezing may cause temporary redness and numbness after the treatment.

Fat cooling is a treatment that uses a special cooling applicator to cool subcutaneous fat and access fat cells that are sensitive to low temperatures.

Immediately after the treatment, you may experience redness, swelling, internal bleeding, or numbness similar to numbness in the cooled area.

These responses are temporary due to the cooling stimulus and are oftenApproximately a few days to 2 weeksThere is a tendency for the situation to gradually subside over time.

Fat freezing downtime and precautions
  • Main reaction: Redness, swelling, internal bleeding, dullness of sensation at the treatment site
  • Estimated progress: In most cases, it subsides within a few days to two weeks.
  • Points to note:Avoid strong pressure or excessive massage on the area immediately after the treatment.
  • Symptoms to keep in mind: Cases where strong pain appears several days after the treatment

However, if you experience severe pain or swelling that does not subside even after the treatment, it is best to consult a clinic as soon as possible.

In rare cases, pain called "delayed onset pain" may appear several days after fat freezing. If you experience severe pain or discomfort for a long time, immediately consult your doctor.

During the downtime period, it is important to be careful not to massage the treated area too hard or apply strong friction or other stimulation.

We recommend that you check the URARA clinic's support system in advance during your consultation regarding the consultation desk and contact methods regarding the progress after the treatment.

GLP-1 receptor agonists require attention to individual differences in nausea and satiety.

GLP-1 receptor agonists are a medical approach that uses drugs that work in the same way as the GLP-1 hormone in the body to support the feeling of fullness and help you manage your style without straining yourself.

Immediately after starting treatment, symptoms such as nausea, heavy stomach, constipation, and diarrhea may occur.Digestive symptomsmay be seen, and the initial prescription dose tends to be milder.

Since the strength and duration of these reactions vary from person to person,Make a note of any changes in your physical condition after the first dose.This will lead to a smooth consultation at your next visit.

Main course and points to note with GLP-1 receptor agonists
  • Gastrointestinal symptoms: Nausea, heavy stomach, constipation, diarrhea, etc. (easily seen at the beginning of use)
  • individual reaction:The feeling and duration may vary depending on the prescription amount and constitution.
  • Nutritional considerations: Consciously intake protein and vitamins when your diet becomes thinner.
  • Principles of use:Do not adjust the dosage at your own discretion, proceed under the judgment of your doctor.

GLP-1 receptor agonists are medical drugs that are prescribed based on a doctor's consultation. Please refrain from changing the dosage at your own discretion or receiving duplicate prescriptions from multiple institutions.

Additionally, due to a decrease in the amount of food you eat, your body may not be getting enough of the nutrients it needs.

If you feel that you are not eating enough, it is best to seek advice from your doctor or specialist staff at the time of your consultation regarding nutritional balance with an emphasis on protein and vitamins.

In addition, when suspending or terminating the program, it is essential that adjustments are made in a planned manner based on the doctor's medical treatment.

Characteristics and precautions for fat-dissolving injections, medical EMS, and genetic testing

Lipolytic injection is a treatment that aims for a local approach by administering a special drug to the fat layer of the area of concern, and there is no possibility of temporary swelling or internal bleeding at the injection site.From a few days to a weekIt may be seen.

Because the affected area will be in a delicate state for several days immediately after the treatment, you will generally be asked to refrain from activities that stimulate blood circulation too much, such as strenuous exercise, long baths, and saunas.

Medical EMS is a device treatment that approaches muscles using electrical stimulation, and is characterized by relatively little physical strain as it does not use a scalpel or injection.

However,pacemakerPlease note that there are contraindications that prevent you from attending the examination if you are wearing medical electronic devices such as or are pregnant, so please notify us in advance.
